kinds.label: Protocol
kinds.description: A standing expectation: how something is to be done, holding until it's revised. There's nothing to tick off — it's kept by living up to it, and the log points back here when it isn't.

kinds.label: Ritual
kinds.description: Something done deliberately, on a rhythm. The one kind with anything to count: track it and it becomes a daily target and a streak on Today.

kinds.label: Limit
kinds.description: A line that isn't crossed. Writing one down isn't a negotiation — it's the record of where a boundary already sits, so neither of you is going on memory.

kinds.label: Safeword
kinds.description: The word that stops things, and what happens once it's said. Written down so it's the same word for both of you at the moment it's needed.
